# Event Staffing Terms

Saffron Table Catering LLP (the "Caterer") and Brightwater Conference Centre Ltd (the "Venue").

## 3. Staffing

3.1 The Caterer shall provide a sufficient number of suitably trained staff for each Event.

3.2 The Venue shall provide changing facilities for the Caterer's staff.

documents.text:
# Rigging Coordination Terms

Lumen Stageworks Ltd (the "Producer") and Kestrel Music Festival CIC (the "Organiser").

## 4. Coordination

4.1 Where the Organiser requests changes to the stage design after the Producer has approved the drawings, it shall notify the other of any resulting delay within 2 days.

4.2 The Producer shall attend the daily site coordination meeting.

documents.title: Grant Payment Terms
documents.text:
# Grant Payment Terms

The Aldermoor Foundation (the "Funder") and Harrowgate Institute of Marine Science (the "Grantee").

## 3. Payment

3.1 The Funder shall pay each instalment within thirty (20) days of approving the relevant progress report.

3.2 Instalments shall be paid by bank transfer to the Grantee's nominated account.
